parameters.value:
={{ $json.action === 'complete' ? {
  questId: $json.questId,
  action: 'complete',
  completionTime: $json.completionStats.totalTime,
  rating: $json.rating,
  feedback: $json.feedback,
  rewards: $json.rewards,
  achievements: $json.achievements,
  timestamp: $json.timestamp
} : $json.action === 'abandon' ? {
  questId: $json.questId,
  action: 'abandon',
  reason: $json.reason,
  progressAtAbandonment: $json.abandonmentStats.progressAtAbandonment,
  timeSpent: $json.abandonmentStats.timeSpent,
  timestamp: $json.timestamp
} : {
  questId: $json.questId,
  action: 'update',
  objectiveId: $json.objectiveId,
  progress: $json.newProgress,
  overallProgress: $json.overallProgress,
  milestones: $json.milestones,
  timestamp: $json.timestamp
} }}
